label: Tier 1 (Basic / Universal Skills)
mechanics: No restriction to buying them all. Usually costs 50 or 100 silver. Available from Teachers without learning the class Breakthrough.

label: Tier 2 (Breakthrough Skill)
mechanics: A Breakthrough Point is spent when learning these. Player has only 3 Breakthrough Points per character, and specialization choice is permanent. Required to access Tier 3 skills in that tree.

label: Tier 3 (Specialization / Advanced Skills)
mechanics: Can only be bought from a tree once you've unlocked that tree's Breakthrough skill. Paired skills (side by side in the tree) are mutually exclusive — choosing one locks out the other.
unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the same tree

label: Special / Quest / Trainer Skills
mechanics: Skills learned from Trainers (usually 50 silver), quest rewards, or faction-exclusive rewards. Not part of a class Breakthrough tree.
